148	    def load_model(
149	        self, filename: str, battery_model: pybamm.BaseModel | None = None
150	    ) -> pybamm.BaseModel:
151	        """
152	        Loads a discretised, ready to solve model into PyBaMM.
153	
154	        A new pybamm battery model instance will be created, which can be solved
155	        and the results plotted as usual.
156	
157	        Currently only available for pybamm models which have previously been written
158	        out using the `save_model()` option.
159	
160	        Warning: This only loads in discretised models. If you wish to make edits to the
161	        model or initial conditions, a new model will need to be constructed seperately.
162	
163	        Parameters
164	        ----------
165	
166	        filename: str
167	            Path to the JSON file containing the serialised model file
168	        battery_model:  :class:`pybamm.BaseModel` (optional)
169	            PyBaMM model to be created (e.g. pybamm.lithium_ion.SPM), which will
170	            override any model names within the file. If None, the function will look
171	            for the saved object path, present if the original model came from PyBaMM.
172	
173	        Returns
174	        -------
175	        :class:`pybamm.BaseModel`
176	            A PyBaMM model object, of type specified either in the JSON or in
177	            `battery_model`.
178	        """
179	
180	        with open(filename) as f:
181	            model_data = json.load(f)
182	
183	        recon_model_dict = {
184	            "name": model_data["name"],
185	            "options": self._convert_options(model_data["options"]),
186	            "bounds": tuple(np.array(bound) for bound in model_data["bounds"]),
187	            "concatenated_rhs": self._reconstruct_expression_tree(
188	                model_data["concatenated_rhs"]
189	            ),
190	            "concatenated_algebraic": self._reconstruct_expression_tree(
191	                model_data["concatenated_algebraic"]
192	            ),
193	            "concatenated_initial_conditions": self._reconstruct_expression_tree(
194	                model_data["concatenated_initial_conditions"]
195	            ),
196	            "events": [
197	                self._reconstruct_expression_tree(event)
198	                for event in model_data["events"]
199	            ],
200	            "mass_matrix": self._reconstruct_expression_tree(model_data["mass_matrix"]),
201	            "mass_matrix_inv": self._reconstruct_expression_tree(
202	                model_data["mass_matrix_inv"]
203	            ),
204	        }
205	
206	        recon_model_dict["geometry"] = (
207	            self._reconstruct_pybamm_dict(model_data["geometry"])
208	            if "geometry" in model_data.keys()
209	            else None
210	        )
211	
212	        recon_model_dict["mesh"] = (
213	            self._reconstruct_mesh(model_data["mesh"])
214	            if "mesh" in model_data.keys()
215	            else None
216	        )
217	
218	        recon_model_dict["variables"] = (
219	            {
220	                k: self._reconstruct_expression_tree(v)
221	                for k, v in model_data["variables"].items()
222	            }
223	            if "variables" in model_data.keys()
224	            else None
225	        )
226	
227	        if battery_model:
228	            return battery_model.deserialise(recon_model_dict)
229	
230	        if "py/object" in model_data.keys():
231	            model_framework = self._get_pybamm_class(model_data)
232	            return model_framework.deserialise(recon_model_dict)
233	
234	        raise TypeError(
235	            """
236	            The PyBaMM battery model to use has not been provided.
237	            """
238	        )
239	
240	    # Helper functions
241	
242	    def _get_pybamm_class(self, snippet: dict):
243	        """Find a pybamm class to initialise from object path"""
244	        parts = snippet["py/object"].split(".")
245	        module = importlib.import_module(".".join(parts[:-1]))
246	
247	        class_ = getattr(module, parts[-1])
248	
249	        try:
250	            empty_class = self._Empty()
251	            empty_class.__class__ = class_
252	
253	            return empty_class
254	
255	        except TypeError:
256	            # Mesh objects have a different layouts
257	            empty_dict_class = self._EmptyDict()
258	            empty_dict_class.__class__ = class_
259	
260	            return empty_dict_class
261	
262	    def _deconstruct_pybamm_dicts(self, dct: dict):
263	        """
264	        Converts dictionaries which contain pybamm classes as keys
265	        into a json serialisable format.
266	
267	        Dictionary keys present as pybamm objects are given a seperate key
268	        as "symbol_<symbol name>" to store the dictionary required to reconstruct
269	        a symbol, and their seperate key is used in the original dictionary. E.G:
270	
271	        {'rod':
272	            {SpatialVariable(name='spat_var'): {"min":0.0, "max":2.0} }
273	            }
274	
275	        converts to
276	
277	        {'rod':
278	            {'symbol_spat_var': {"min":0.0, "max":2.0} },
279	        'spat_var':
280	            {"py/object":pybamm....}
281	        }
282	
283	        Dictionaries which don't contain pybamm symbols are returned unchanged.
284	        """
285	
286	        def nested_convert(obj):
287	            if isinstance(obj, dict):
288	                new_dict = {}
289	                for k, v in obj.items():
290	                    if isinstance(k, pybamm.Symbol):
291	                        new_k = self._SymbolEncoder().default(k)
292	                        new_dict["symbol_" + new_k["name"]] = new_k
293	                        k = new_k["name"]
294	                    new_dict[k] = nested_convert(v)
295	                return new_dict
296	            return obj
297	
298	        try:
299	            _ = json.dumps(dct)
300	            return dict(dct)
301	        except TypeError:  # dct must contain pybamm objects
302	            return nested_convert(dct)
303	
304	    def _reconstruct_symbol(self, dct: dict):
305	        """Reconstruct an individual pybamm Symbol"""
306	        symbol_class = self._get_pybamm_class(dct)
307	        symbol = symbol_class._from_json(dct)
308	        return symbol
309	
310	    def _reconstruct_expression_tree(self, node: dict):
311	        """
312	        Loop through an expression tree creating pybamm Symbol classes
313	
314	        Conducts post-order tree traversal to turn each tree node into a
315	        `pybamm.Symbol` class, starting from leaf nodes without children and
316	        working upwards.
317	
318	        Parameters
319	        ----------
320	        node: dict
321	            A node in an expression tree.
322	        """
323	        if "children" in node:
324	            for i, c in enumerate(node["children"]):
325	                child_obj = self._reconstruct_expression_tree(c)
326	                node["children"][i] = child_obj
327	        elif "expression" in node:
328	            expression_obj = self._reconstruct_expression_tree(node["expression"])
329	            node["expression"] = expression_obj
330	
331	        obj = self._reconstruct_symbol(node)
332	
333	        return obj
334	
335	    def _reconstruct_mesh(self, node: dict):
336	        """Reconstructs a Mesh object"""
337	        if "sub_meshes" in node:
338	            for k, v in node["sub_meshes"].items():
339	                sub_mesh = self._reconstruct_symbol(v)
340	                node["sub_meshes"][k] = sub_mesh
341	
342	        new_mesh = self._reconstruct_symbol(node)
343	
344	        return new_mesh
345	
346	    def _reconstruct_pybamm_dict(self, obj: dict):
347	        """
348	        pybamm.Geometry can contain PyBaMM symbols as dictionary keys.
349	
350	        Converts
351	        {"rod":
352	            {"symbol_spat_var":
353	                {"min":0.0, "max":2.0} },
354	            "spat_var":
355	                {"py/object":"pybamm...."}
356	        }
357	
358	        from an exported JSON file to
359	
360	        {"rod":
361	            {SpatialVariable(name="spat_var"): {"min":0.0, "max":2.0} }
362	            }
363	        """
364	
365	        def recurse(obj):
366	            if isinstance(obj, dict):
367	                new_dict = {}
368	                for k, v in obj.items():
369	                    if "symbol_" in k:
370	                        new_dict[k] = self._reconstruct_symbol(v)
371	                    elif isinstance(v, dict):
372	                        new_dict[k] = recurse(v)
373	                    else:
374	                        new_dict[k] = v
375	
376	                pattern = re.compile("symbol_")
377	                symbol_keys = {k: v for k, v in new_dict.items() if pattern.match(k)}
378	
379	                # rearrange the dictionary to make pybamm objects the dictionary keys
380	                if symbol_keys:
381	                    for k, v in symbol_keys.items():
382	                        new_dict[v] = new_dict[k.lstrip("symbol_")]
383	                        del new_dict[k]
384	                        del new_dict[k.lstrip("symbol_")]
385	
386	                return new_dict
387	            return obj
388	
389	        return recurse(obj)
390	
391	    def _convert_options(self, d):
392	        """
393	        Converts a dictionary with nested lists to nested tuples,
394	        used to convert model options back into correct format
395	        """
396	        if isinstance(d, dict):
397	            return {k: self._convert_options(v) for k, v in d.items()}
398	        elif isinstance(d, list):
399	            return tuple(self._convert_options(item) for item in d)
400	        else:
401	            return d
